beforeSql.query:
SELECT
            inventory.id,
            seat.seat_label,
            seat.row_no,
            seat.seat_no,
            zone.name AS zone,
            inventory.price
        FROM session_seats AS inventory
        JOIN seats AS seat ON seat.id = inventory.seat_id
        JOIN venue_zones AS zone ON zone.id = seat.zone_id AND zone.venue_id = seat.venue_id
        WHERE inventory.session_id = $1 AND EXISTS(SELECT $2 FROM sessions s JOIN events e ON e.id=s.event_id WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.status<>$3 AND e.status<>$4)
        ORDER BY zone.sort_order ASC,
                 seat.row_no ASC,
                 seat.seat_no ASC,
                 inventory.id ASC

afterSql.query: SELECT s.id,s.venue_id,(extract($2 FROM s.created_at)*$3)::bigint created,coalesce((extract($4 FROM e.published_at)*$5)::bigint,$6) published FROM sessions s JOIN events e ON e.id=s.event_id WHERE s.id=$1 AND s.status<>$7 AND e.status<>$8

PostgreSQL rows are returned rows from pg_stat_statements, not physical buffer-page scans.
OBSERVE/ENFORCED capability results are excluded from OFF improvements.
